metrics.name: parts check separation
metrics.evidence: only a strict parts check separates what draws from what is right (15 of 34).

metrics.name: failures on unseen hard prompts
metrics.about: An optimiser's prompt is only as honest as its metric
metrics.evidence: barring the escape hatch cut failures on unseen hard prompts from 84% to 30%.

metrics.name: XML failures turned into successes
metrics.about: State the extraction rule beside the rate
metrics.evidence: Taking the longest code block instead of the first turned 15 complete chain-of-thought answers from "XML failures" into successes

metrics.name: failed trials with default xmlns
metrics.about: Make the error message name the fix
metrics.evidence: A default xmlns on the root fails 32 trials with "No matching global declaration", which does not say to remove it

metrics.name: roughness occurrences let through
metrics.about: An optimiser's prompt is only as honest as its metric
metrics.evidence: The Full-allowed prompt still lets roughness through in 18 scenes and declares Full in every valid one
